terms.comment: Classically a copy of a letter or a book (Plin. Ep. 4.7.2: liber in exemplāria trānscrīptus mīlle), and Traupman gives it for a copy on a computer (p. 260); a backup is such a copy, and calling it so is our use. No reference work has a separate word for a backup. To make one is exemplar facere (Traupman 260).

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 260.
No source has a word for a backup.
